selection_reason: Bounded canary local choice: lowest officially published worst-case token price; not an official model recommendation.
reasoning_chat_distinction: The current official API exposes thinking enabled/disabled on both current model names. It does not document separate current chat and reasoning model names on the audited pages.

pricing.deduction_rule: token_count multiplied by the corresponding per-token price
pricing.change_warning: Current prices were unchanged at refresh. Official peak/off-peak pricing begins 2026-08-16T16:00:00Z, after the planned B4 window; re-audit if the acceptance window crosses that boundary.

approved_budget_projection.assumption: All 150000 daily input safety tokens are cache misses and all 80000 daily output safety tokens are used.
approved_budget_projection.policy: USD 2 remains a hard cap and overrides token ceilings after any price change.

streaming.non_streaming: HTTP 200 chat completion object with usage object
streaming.streaming: SSE data-only chunks terminated by data: [DONE]
streaming.stream_usage: When stream_options.include_usage is true, an additional pre-DONE chunk carries total usage; other chunks carry null usage.

401.official_meaning: Authentication fails due to wrong API key

429.official_meaning: Rate limit reached / requests sent too quickly

500.official_meaning: Server error; official page suggests retry after a brief wait

503.official_meaning: Server overloaded; official page suggests retry after a brief wait

timeout_retry_guidance.b3_policy: Timeout after send becomes UNKNOWN_CHARGE_STATE and is never automatically retried.

unknowns: Official recommended model for this report workload
Charge/execution state for HTTP 429 and HTTP 5xx
Provider retry ceiling and backoff schedule
Whether omitted cache token fields imply cache miss
Exact tokenizer parity without running the official offline tokenizer
